mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS below 0.5%) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% (t-test p>0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate exceeding 5.5% signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.5% (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in payroll growth (PAYEMS) and increases in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate a deteriorating labor market, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced consumer demand.
failure_condition: The interaction effect between PAYEMS decline and UNRATE rise fails to predict negative returns (Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: During a housing market recovery (HOUST above 1200 thousand units), increased residential construction drives economic expansion, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1200 (t-test p>0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO below 100) signals a contraction in manufacturing and services, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate profits decline.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls below 100 (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates central bank policy accommodation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of CPIAUCSL rise and FEDFUNDS decline fails to predict positive returns (Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: A rising quarterly GDP growth rate (GDPC1) supports corporate earnings expansion, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth is positive (t-test p>0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A falling unemployment rate below 4.5% signals a tight labor market, boosting wage growth and consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE falls below 4.5 (t-test p>0.05).
